items.title: Bowie Playhouse: "Pippin"
items.summary: Event date: October 1, 2026 Event Time: 07:30 PM - 09:30 PM Location: 16500 White Marsh Park Drive Bowie, MD 20715 Description: With an infectiously unforgettable score by four-time Grammy winner and three-time Oscar winner Stephen Schwartz, "Pippin" follows a young prince on his journey to discover what it truly means to be extraordinary. This updated, circus-inspired musical explores ambition, love, family, and the search for fulfillment as Pippin discovers that happiness may be found not in extraordinary accomplishments, but in the everyday moments of life. Presented by 2nd Star Productions at the Bowie Playhouse, this captivating musical is sure to entertain audiences of all ages.

items.title: Senior Program: Vaccine Clinic
items.summary: Event date: October 13, 2026 Event Time: 09:30 AM - 03:00 PM Location: 14900 Health Center Drive Bowie, MD 20716 Description: In partnership with Safeway Pharmacy, there will be a vaccine clinic at the Senior Center.
